entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An elven aether researcher who lives in the inquirium, follows the Great Conduit, and builds a matter transporter from her aether condenser to win the Inventors' Fair.

entities.name: Mitul
entities.description: Rashmi's methodical vedalken assistant and friend, who records every trial and secretly dabbles in underground duelling.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A renowned metalsmith, planeswalker and Rashmi's friend, who first refuses to help with the transporter out of fear of its danger and then repairs the filament.

entities.name: Padeem
entities.description: A vedalken consul and judge of the Inventors' Fair, once a famed underground quicksmith, who grants Rashmi and Mitul an audience.

entities.name: Remi
entities.description: A tall blue shopkeeper in Ghirapur whose shop runs out of filaments.

entities.name: Zara
entities.description: A young dwarf fan who asks Saheeli to sign her autograph booklet.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: An inspector whose displeasure the arena announcer fears.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The capital city of Kaladesh, hosting the Inventors' Fair.

entities.name: Inquirium
entities.description: Rashmi's beetle-like research facility in Ghirapur's central square.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane of inventors and aether where the Inventors' Fair takes place.

entities.name: Remi's shop
entities.description: A Ghirapur parts shop out of WP series filaments.

entities.name: Inventors' Fair
entities.description: The festival of invention in Ghirapur where inventors compete for patrons and the Consulate's support.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The government of Kaladesh whose support Rashmi seeks.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: A group that uses a secret code to arrange underground automaton battles.

entities.name: Matter transporter
entities.description: A golden hoop powered by Rashmi's aether condenser that moves matter across space and disintegrates organic subjects.

entities.name: Aether condenser
entities.description: Rashmi's groundbreaking device for powering matter transportation.

entities.name: Great Conduit
entities.description: A force Rashmi sees in the aether and believes guides her toward success.

entities.name: Aether
entities.description: The energy of Kaladesh, observed in flowing patterns.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes whose dangers Saheeli knows as a planeswalker.

events.summary: Rashmi builds a matter transporter around her aether condenser for the Inventors' Fair.
events.quote: But only Rashmi had a device capable of powering such a venture.

events.summary: Test subject 848, a flower, disintegrates in the transporter.
events.quote: Trial failed. Test subject 848 disintegrated,

events.summary: Mitul notes traces of transmuted matter, and they plan a more stable aether stream.
events.quote: measurements detected traces of transmuted matter

events.summary: Rashmi and Mitul face qualifiers within a week, hoping for the Consulate's support.
events.quote: The Inventors' Fair qualifiers were less than a week away.

events.summary: On the afternoon of the qualifiers, exhausted, they prepare their last trial with test subject 887.
events.quote: It was the afternoon of Inventors' Fair qualifiers, and they had not yet run a successful trial.

events.summary: The 887th flower implodes and the filament snaps.
events.quote: POP! The flower imploded.

events.summary: Rashmi begins to confess that the inquirium is in financial trouble.
events.quote: I should have told you long ago.

events.summary: Mitul points out that the vase from the table has been transported across the room into a circle.
events.quote: There, leaning against the wall inside a small inscribed circle, was the vase.

events.summary: Mitul confirms they transported inorganic matter across space.
events.quote: We successfully transported inorganic matter across space.

events.summary: Mitul admits they have no spare filament.
events.quote: We do not have another filament.

events.summary: Fair automatons hawk attractions at Rashmi and Mitul and block their way to the market.
events.quote: Welcome to the Inventors' Fair!

events.summary: Remi's shop has no WP series filament and no restock for days.
events.quote: The back's as cleared-out as the storefront.

events.summary: Every shop in Ghirapur turns out to be out of the needed filament.
events.quote: It seemed that there wasn't a WP series filament in all of Ghirapur.

events.summary: Heartbroken, Rashmi tells Mitul they must close the inquirium and walks away.
events.quote: Mitul, we're going to have to close down the inquirium.

events.summary: Saheeli finds Rashmi at the inquirium and learns the filament broke.
events.quote: The bright young inventor was standing in the middle of the workshop

events.summary: Saheeli offers to speak to Padeem about the aether condenser.
events.quote: I know Padeem well enough.

events.summary: Rashmi tells Saheeli about the working matter transporter.
events.quote: Mitul and I designed a matter transporter, and it works!

events.summary: Saheeli refuses to help, saying the device is too dangerous.
events.quote: It's too dangerous.

events.summary: Rashmi accuses Saheeli of jealousy as she leaves.
events.quote: Are you jealous?

events.summary: Saheeli spends the night in automaton duels with the renegades at the arena.
events.quote: Saheeli had been automaton dueling with the renegades all through the night.

events.summary: Saheeli reasons she has a responsibility as a planeswalker who knows about the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: She had a responsibility being a Planeswalker, knowing what she knew about the Blind Eternities.

events.summary: Saheeli wins her twenty-fifth duel of the night.
events.quote: Which puts her at a perfect twenty-five for the night!

events.summary: Signing a young fan's autograph book, Saheeli reads her own quote about innovation without bounds and is shaken.
events.quote: Well, isn't that something to have shoved in your face?

events.summary: Saheeli returns to the inquirium and Mitul slams the door in her face.
events.quote: Mitul slammed the door in her face.

events.summary: Saheeli offers a new filament and says Padeem will give Rashmi an audience if it works.
events.quote: Padeem promised me she would give you an audience if it works.

events.summary: The transporter successfully moves the vase across the room, and Saheeli hopes she did the right thing.
events.quote: The ring floated up from the table, and as it did, the vase flickered away.

events.summary: Saheeli reveals she bought Padeem's audience with a front-row duel seat.
events.quote: A front-row seat at the underground artificer duel next month.

events.summary: Rashmi learns that Padeem was once an underground quicksmith.
events.quote: The best of her time,

events.summary: Saheeli apologizes and she and Rashmi reconcile.
events.quote: Rashmi drew Saheeli into an embrace.

events.summary: Rashmi and Mitul present the transporter to Padeem, who tells Rashmi to impress her.
events.quote: All right, Inventor Rashmi, impress me.

relations.note: He is her assistant and research partner.
relations.quote: Her vedalken assistant, Mitul, placed the tool on her palm.

relations.note: They are close research partners and friends.
relations.quote: such a gifted research partner and friend in Mitul
Rashmi drew Saheeli into an embrace.

relations.note: She is a consul and judge.
relations.quote: The consul will see you now.

relations.note: She and Mitul designed it around her aether condenser.
relations.quote: Mitul and I designed a matter transporter, and it works!
